7984722962286.variantName: Costway 6 FT/184 CM Artificial Pre-Lit Christmas Tree Hinged
7984722962286.sourceDescription:
Celebrate Christmas with pastel macaron tones with this dreamy holiday tree.Boasting a soft pastel palette that departs from conventional deep green evergreens, this artificial fir offers whimsical romantic charm throughout your space. Loaded with 910 lush branch tips and vibrant PVC foliage, it forms a naturally full rounded silhouette; simply fluff the twigs to reveal rich dimensional texture. Pre-lit with 250 warm white LED bulbs and powered by a UKCA certified adapter, it casts steady soft illumination that highlights the pastel foliage and fills your space with immersive festive warmth. Featuring a 3 section hinged frame and folding metal stand, the tree sets up quickly, and included gloves protect your hands while shaping branches. Constructed from 100% new PVC material, this 6 ft tree maintains its beautiful appearance season after year, with flame-retardant, anti-fading, non-allergic and smell-free properties for worry-free indoor holiday decorating. Note: Ornaments are not included.
Folding metal stand ensures convenient storage
3-section structure for easy setup
250 warm white LED lights for soft festive radiance
Hinged branches automatically spread out to the designated space

Material: PVC, Metal

Diameter of Stand: 18"/45 cm
Number of Branch Tips: 910
Number of LED Lights: 250

Net Weight: 7 kg
PackageIncludes:
1 x Christmas Tree
2 x Pairs of Gloves
1 x User Guide
Guarantee - 6 months

Snow-flocked, dense branches: With 64 branches featuring snow-flocked ends and decorated with six pine cones, the small lush Christmas tree perfectly captures the snowy winter atmosphere and brings a strong festive vibe.

Compact indoor festive essential: Standing 60 cm tall and 41 cm wide, this mini Christmas tree is great for tabletops, living rooms, entryways and other small indoor spaces, bringing Christmas cheer anywhere—battery operated for cordless convenience.

Crochet Christmas Decorations
These crochet Christmas decorations add a festive detail to your Christmas display. The red finish and polyester construction give them a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Handmade Detail
Handmade detailing contributes to the character of the design. The decorative elements give the product a distinct appearance that can be coordinated with the surrounding arrangement.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Product details

Vibrant red polyester construction provides a defined, traditional look for holiday decorating.
Compact dimensions of 17 cm x 15 cm allow versatile placement on trees or shelves.
Single item pack offers a flexible finishing touch to coordinate with existing decor.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Included: 1 piece

 Perfect For
 Front Door & Entrance — A soft welcome that keeps interiors clean

Before Use: Ensure the floor and the mat's underside are clean and dry for best grip
Daily Cleaning: Vacuum or brush regularly to remove loose dirt
Deep Cleaning: Wash with water where appropriate, or machine wash gently if suitable for your machine and the mat
Drying: Allow the mat to dry thoroughly before placing it back on the floor

Crafted from crystal velvet with a soft, skin-friendly texture that's warm and cosy underfoot. More than a doormat — a soft landing that lets every homecoming begin in comfort.
The non-slip backing keeps the mat firmly positioned through daily traffic — no slipping or shifting underfoot. Extra peace of mind for every step through the door.
The absorbent surface quickly soaks up water and moisture tracked in from shoes and feet, keeping your floor dry and clean — no more trail of wet prints on rainy days.
Vacuum or brush for daily dust, rinse with water or machine wash where suitable — flexible cleaning that keeps it fresh and hygienic with minimal effort.
Unique printed patterns add a fashionable finishing touch, while the round shape suits any interior. Entryway, bedroom, garage, patio, office — beautiful wherever it goes.
Five sizes from 40×40cm to 120×120cm — from a compact doormat to a generous round rug, there's a size that's just right.

7984722957886.sourceDescription:
Transform your home's entrance with this 61 cm winter-inspired holiday wreath, beautifully coated in thick, snowy-white flocking that captures the magic of freshly fallen snow. Crafted from 106 lush branch tips, large pine needles, and vibrant PVC foliage, this festive decoration offers a rich, full-bodied look. The artificial wreath features 35 pre-lit LED lights that offer 2 lighting colors and 8 lighting modes, including combination, C1 and C2 in wave, C1 and C2 sequential, C1 and C2 slow fade, C1 and C2 steady on, and slo-glo. All modes are controlled by an automatic timer for hassle-free ambiance. Constructed from flame-retardant, non-allergenic, and fade-resistant PVC, this decorative wreath ensures safety and longevity throughout the season. Thanks to its IP44-rated battery box, it can be easily displayed indoors or outside on your door, porch, or wall. Wishing you a merry Christmas and cozy holiday joy with this elegant winter wreath.
Features wintry white flocking for natural charm
Boasts 35 pre-lit LED lights for magical ambiance
With 2 lighting color options, warm white and colorful
Provides an auto timer function (6 hours on, 18 hours off)
Color: White
Material: PVC, Metal
Outer Diameter: 61 cm
Inner Diameter: 33 cm
Number of Branch Tips: 106
Number of LED Lights: 35
Net Weight (Each Wreath): 1 kg
PackageIncludes:
1 x Christmas Wreaths
Batteries included
Guarantee - 6 months

Bring dark green foliage into your seasonal decorating with this pack of 4 artificial ficus garlands, each measuring 1.8m. Pointed leaf shapes branch along the garland, bringing an open leafy outline and a glittered surface to festive arrangements. The glitter finish adds a decorative accent to Christmas displays, while the dark green colour helps coordinate the arrangement with your chosen ribbons and ornaments. Lay a length along a mantel, arrange it around a banister or incorporate it into a festive window display. The artificial leaves can also form part of Christmas table centrepieces, wreath-making projects and indoor wedding decorations, allowing the same foliage style to appear in different areas. Plan each length around the space available and position your own accessories alongside it to complete the look. This option contains 4 separate garlands, allowing you to repeat the design across several locations or arrange individual lengths alongside one another. Combine the glittered foliage with plain decorations for contrasting texture, or use it within a wider festive colour theme for your home or party setting.
Glitter Ficus Garland: Includes 4 matching dark green artificial ficus leaf garlands, each measuring 1.8m. The glitter finish adds colour and texture to Christmas tree decorations, mantel arrangements and festive table displays, with decorative foliage spaced along the length for a leafy seasonal accent.
Decorative Leaf Design: Pointed leaf shapes branch along the garland, bringing an open leafy outline and a glittered surface to festive arrangements. The dark green colour can be used as the main accent or combined with other seasonal decorations, adding a leafy detail to indoor Christmas and party displays.
Mantel And Stair Decor: Arrange the 1.8m foliage length along a mantel, position it around a banister or use it within a Christmas window display. Plan the layout to suit your space, then add your own ribbons and ornaments to coordinate the garland with nearby festive decorations.
Table And Wreath Arrangements: Incorporate the dark green ficus foliage into Christmas table centrepieces, decorative wreath projects or indoor wedding displays. The glittered leaves provide a repeated accent that can link place settings, mantel greenery and other seasonal arrangements.
Pack Size And Coverage: Contains 4 separate garlands, each with a 1.8m decorative length. Arrange the individual lengths across separate areas or alongside one another. Coordinate with your own ribbons and ornaments to carry the foliage theme through your indoor seasonal arrangement.

For Indoor & outdoor Use

5096042275686.baseName: LED Christmas wreath - Illuminated Christmas decoration - 50 warm white LEDs, hanging cord for doors and walls - Green, 50 cm
5096042275686.variantName: LED Christmas wreath - Illuminated Christmas decoration - 50 warm white LEDs, hanging cord for doors and walls - Green, 50 cm
5096042275686.sourceDescription:
Natural pine cones give the greenery a textured finish, while 50 warm white LEDs illuminate the arrangement. A cord at the top provides a hanging point. Have AA batteries ready for the lights as these are supplied separately. It can be used indoors or outdoors, so the same decoration can move between a hallway and an entrance as your plans change.

The lighting gives this wreath two different uses in the same spot. In natural daylight the decorative details provide the colour and texture. Once the lights are switched on, the outline is still visible from the far end of a hall. Allow access to the battery compartment when arranging the display. Positioning it where you can change the cells without disturbing the front of the decoration makes a difference if you leave it up throughout the season.

From a few steps away the cones read as dark accents. Closer up, their overlapping scales contrast with the finer foliage. A simple ribbon or a nearby wooden decoration will pick up that woodland detail. For a simpler finish, keep additional decorations to one part of the ring and let the natural shape of the foliage show elsewhere. A ribbon tied off-centre can pick up a colour from the tree without covering the sprigs.

Warm white light works well alongside wood, brass and cream finishes. If you already have lighting in the same part of the room, see how the two colours look together at dusk before choosing the final position.

To carry the colours into the rest of the room, pick out one detail from the wreath and repeat it in wrapping ribbon, a table runner or decorations on the tree. Even a single matching accent can bring two separate displays together. For a calm scheme, carry one colour from the decoration into a nearby ornament and leave the space immediately around the wreath clear.
Illuminated with 50 warm white LEDs for festive glow
Decorated with natural pine cones for textured finish
Includes hanging cord for easy door or wall display
Suitable for both indoor and outdoor seasonal use
Comes with Hanging cord
Hanging rope included

5096042276386.variantName: LED Christmas wreath - Christmas wreath with lights - Natural pine cones and gold ornaments for a festive entrance - 32 x 9 cm
5096042276386.sourceDescription:
Natural pine cones and gold ornaments give this arrangement a mix of rough and smooth finishes. The warm white lights pick up the metallic details among the evergreen accents, making them stand out when the room grows darker. The decoration measures 32 x 9 cm.

The lighting gives this wreath two different uses in the same spot. In natural daylight the decorative details provide the colour and texture. Once the lights are switched on, the outline is still visible from the far end of a hall. Warm white light works well alongside wood, brass and cream finishes. If you already have lighting in the same part of the room, see how the two colours look together at dusk before choosing the final position.

From a few steps away the cones read as dark accents. Closer up, their overlapping scales contrast with the finer foliage. A simple ribbon or a nearby wooden decoration will pick up that woodland detail. A green wreath also works as a bridge between rooms. Choose one shade from your tree decorations for the hallway and repeat it in a small accent beside the wreath, letting the greenery carry the rest of the scheme.

If you already have a busy Christmas tree, give the wreath a space of its own. A quiet patch of wall brings the outline into focus and gives visitors a chance to see the individual details as they pass. A lit wreath can provide the evening detail in a hallway where there is little space for a tree. Keeping the surface below it simple lets the outline show up after dark and leaves room for the everyday use of the entrance.

If you are using other Christmas lighting nearby, try the wreath on its own first. A little distance between the light sources helps each point remain visible and lets the pattern around the wreath read clearly. Think about access to the controls before choosing the final position.
Adorn your entrance with natural pine cones and gold ornaments for a festive woodland look.
Integrated warm white LED lights highlight metallic details and create a welcoming glow at dusk.
Compact dimensions of 32 x 9 cm make it ideal for hallways or small spaces without overwhelming the area.
Combines rough natural textures with smooth evergreen accents for a sophisticated seasonal display.

Add a stunning frosted finish to your staircase, mantel or doorway with the Aurora Winter Glow Christmas Garland. Flocked in soft white "snow" along realistic PE pine-needle branches, this generously full garland is finished with natural pinecones and frosted red berries for a beautifully festive winter look.

Pre-lit with 70 warm white LEDs, the Aurora Winter Glow adds a soft, welcoming glow to your display — perfect for draping along banisters, mantels, or doorframes throughout the festive season.

What's included
1 x Aurora Winter Glow Christmas Garland

Dimensions
Length: 270cm (9ft)

Good to know
Powered by battery box (3xAA batteries required, not included)
IP44 rated — suitable for sheltered outdoor use (e.g. covered porches, entranceways)
Sent by courier with free standard UK delivery
Returns accepted within 30 days
Covered by a 1-year manufacturer warranty
Contains small parts (berries/pinecones) — keep away from children

FAQs
Does it need assembly?
No assembly required. Simply unfold and shape the branches, then drape or position as desired.

How are the lights powered?
The garland is battery-operated (batteries required, not included), making it easy to display anywhere without needing a nearby plug socket.

What colour are the lights?
The garland is lit with warm white LEDs for a soft, cosy glow.

Can I use it outdoors?
Yes. This garland is IP44 rated, making it suitable for covered/sheltered outdoor areas such as porches or entranceways. It's not recommended for direct exposure to heavy rain.

Is it safe around children and pets?
The garland contains small decorative parts (berries and pinecones) that may present a swallowing hazard. We recommend keeping it out of reach of young children and pets who may be tempted to chew or pull them off.

Is it covered by a warranty?
Yes. It comes with a 1-year manufacturer warranty.

How is it delivered?
Sent by courier with free standard UK delivery.

Christmas Village
This Christmas village adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The white finish and fabric construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Snowflake Detail
Snowflake detailing adds a winter themed accent to the design. The pattern can be used alongside simpler decorations to vary the visual texture of a seasonal arrangement while keeping the display within a coordinated festive theme.

Reusable Design
The reusable format is intended to be used again after suitable care. Keep it clean and store it between uses so it remains ready for the next occasion.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

4250525308686.variantName: Spielwerk 3-Storey German Christmas Pyramid Windmill, Hand-Painted Rotating Christmas Decoration for Home
4250525308686.sourceDescription:
This classic ornament bridges the gap between historical heritage and timeless seasonal room styling. Crafted with precision, the three ascending tiers showcase a traditional nativity silhouette scene populated with carefully styled, hand-painted figurines and intricate festive detailing. Constructed with a robust wooden framework finished in a natural warm brown tone, this durable tabletop ornament provides an eco-friendly alternative to electrical lighting displays. It creates a cosy, inviting atmosphere on cold winter evenings without requiring mains power or batteries.
Unlike modern plastic or electronic decorations, this authentic wooden windmill functions through pure thermodynamic engineering. By placing six standard candles into the integrated perimeter holders, the rising heat currents from the flames naturally rise to meet the upper fan blades. This gentle updraft sets the central axle and all three decorative storeys into a smooth, silent rotating motion, casting warm flickering shadows across your living room, dining space, or hallway.
The classic tiered layout features a traditional nativity scene silhouette that gently rotates using natural thermal power from the candle heat rise.
Each wooden tier is carefully assembled with hand-painted character figurines and delicate decorative fretwork to bring an authentic heritage aesthetic into your living space.
Engineered to operate entirely without batteries or electricity by utilizing the ascending heat currents from six candles to smoothly drive the upper fan blades.
Built with six integrated candle holders positioned around the solid base structure, making it perfectly compatible with standard seasonal wax lights.
Designed with a stable wide-base footprint that fits beautifully on mantelpieces, dining tables, windowsills, or sideboards as a striking seasonal focal point.
Guarantee - 6 months
Suitable for Indoor use
Position the pyramid on a completely flat, rigid, and heat-resistant surface away from draughts, open windows, or heavy foot traffic to prevent tipping and ensure even rotation.
